home.tagline: A gift they unwrap on their phone
home.title: Turn a surprise into a story
home.subtitle: Add photos, messages and voice notes. They scan a QR code, swipe through your story and reveal the surprise at the end.
home.step1Text: Photos, words, your voice and a trivia question only they can answer.
home.step2Text: A scratch card, a boarding pass or a gift box to open.
home.step3Text: Print it, stick it in a card or send the link.
